name: Oblivion Lost Remake Semi-Official Patches: Standalone
summary:
Oblivion Lost Remake Semi-Official Patches: Standalone is a fan-made project based on the Oblivion Lost Remake 3.0 mod, developed under the leadership of Hrust and Vector.

SOP introduces numerous gameplay and graphical improvements, tweaks, and bug fixes to the original mod without altering the gist of the storyline. Instead, it focuses on completely reworking the visual style to match the spring-summer 2003 aesthetic, aiming to perfectly capture the legendary concept of "the Old Good Stalker".
